skill.description: Creates safe email personalization specifications from existing copy, segment maps, and export columns. Maps merge tags, defines conditional content, audits fallbacks, and limits PII exposure.

content.value_statement: Missing customer data can break personalized emails or expose sensitive information. This skill maps fields, defines fallbacks, and audits conditional content before rendering.
actual_capabilities: Maps each email merge tag to a provided export column.
Defines a natural fallback value for every personalized field.
Creates segment-based conditional rules with a catch-all branch.
Audits worst-case renders for missing fields and unmatched segments.
Identifies sensitive fields that should not appear in visible email content.
limitations: Requires existing email copy and an existing segment map or column list.
Does not create audience segments or write the base email campaign.
Does not verify live ESP syntax or sync templates without separate platform tooling.
Cannot calculate reliable fill rates unless the user provides export data or measurements.

use_cases.title: Prepare lifecycle campaigns
use_cases.description: Add safe first-name, location, and product fields to retention emails with reliable defaults.

use_cases.title: Build segment variations
use_cases.description: Define loyalty, win-back, and default content branches from an approved audience map.

use_cases.title: Review privacy and fallbacks
use_cases.description: Check a personalized template for empty renders, unsupported claims, and exposed customer data.

prompt_templates.title: Map basic merge tags
prompt_templates.prompt: Map the merge tags in this email to these export columns. Add a natural fallback for every tag: [creative and columns].
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner mapping for an existing email.

prompt_templates.title: Create segment rules
prompt_templates.prompt: Define conditional content for these named segments. Include one variation per segment and a safe catch-all branch: [creative and segment map].

prompt_templates.title: Audit fallback safety
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this personalized email with every field empty and every condition unmatched. Report broken grammar, empty content, and unsafe PII: [template].

prompt_templates.title: Design a complete specification
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a personalization specification from this creative, segment map, columns, fill rates, and approved claims. Include mappings, conditions, audit results, and PII rules.

output_examples.input: A welcome email uses first name, but the field is complete for only 82 percent of subscribers.
output_examples.output: Use first name when present and the neutral greeting “there” otherwise. The worst-case greeting remains natural and contains no empty punctuation.

output_examples.input: Champions receive a loyalty offer, at-risk customers receive a win-back offer, and all other subscribers need valid content.
output: Champions: show the approved loyalty variation.
At-risk customers: show the approved win-back variation.
Everyone else: show the base offer as the required default.

output_examples.input: The proposed template includes email address, street address, city, and last product category.
output_examples.output: Allow city and a broad product category. Block email address and street address from visible content, then use coarser substitutes.

best_practices: Provide exact export column names and measured fill rates before selecting personalized fields.
Test every template with empty values and unmatched segments before implementation.
Use aggregate rules and synthetic examples instead of sharing subscriber records.
anti_patterns: Do not invent segment names, export columns, fill rates, or approved promotional claims.
Do not use bare merge tags when missing data would break grammar or meaning.
Do not place email addresses, phone numbers, precise addresses, or order identifiers in visible content.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the existing email copy, named segments, export columns, campaign mode, and fill rates when available.

faq.question: Does this skill create audience segments?
faq.answer: No. It applies personalization to existing segments and asks for a segment map when one is missing.

faq.question: Can it write the complete email?
faq.answer: No. It adds merge tags and conditional rules to existing copy but does not create the base message.

faq.question: How does it handle missing customer data?
faq.answer: It assigns explicit fallbacks, recommends conditionals when needed, and reviews the worst-case rendered message.

faq.question: How does it protect personal data?
faq.answer: It works from columns and aggregate rules, blocks sensitive fields, and avoids reproducing real subscriber values.

faq.question: Does it support every email platform?
faq.answer: It produces platform-neutral specifications. Exact syntax and template synchronization require separate platform guidance or tooling.
